assumptions.choice: Treat the 15:59 timestamp as the last one-minute bar of each complete regular AAPL trading day and enable Backtrader cheat-on-close execution so a forced close submitted on that bar fills at that bar's close.
assumptions.reason: The feed has no explicit session-end field, and ordinary Backtrader market orders submitted while processing the last bar cannot execute at the already-observed close.

assumptions.choice: Use plain self.buy() and self.sell() with the harness's default sizer.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a fixed size but gives 100% of available capital only as an example, so no exact size is stated and the canonical default applies.

assumptions.choice: Do not force a close at the dataset cutoff of 12:25 because it is not the end of the trading day.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires closure at the end of each trading day, not at an arbitrary end-of-data cutoff, and the strategy is not informed that the current bar is the final supplied bar.
